pieces.title: Order Up, Week 4
pieces.dek: Justin Jefferson is inactive, so Jordan Addison is the play, and Rachaad White sat in London.

pieces.title: Prep Notes, Week 4
pieces.dek: Justin Jefferson is doubtful, so Jordan Addison is the Minnesota receiver to play, and Nico Collins is off the report.

pieces.title: The Menu, Week 4
pieces.dek: The order is refreshed for Sunday: Jared Goff is a top-8 quarterback against CAR's depleted secondary, Patrick Mahomes is QB5, Jeremiyah Love is a top-8 back, and Puka Nacua and Justin Jefferson are back on the board with flags.

pieces.title: Serve or Sit, Week 4
pieces.dek: Jeremiyah Love is a borderline RB1 after one game as the lead, Omarion Hampton is a sit at RB20 until the Menu catches up to his usage, and Jaylen Warren is the Thursday night back.

pieces.title: Heat Check, Week 4
pieces.dek: Rashee Rice went from 2 targets to 6 to 9. The Kansas City passing game is his again.

pieces.title: Butcher Shop, Week 4
pieces.dek: Chris Olave has 36 targets and one touchdown. That price will not last, so go get him today.

pieces.title: Market Run, Week 4
pieces.dek: Ollie Gordon II took 84 percent of Miami's snaps after Achane's ACL, and he is the first name on this week's list.

pieces.title: Leftovers, Week 3
pieces.dek: Ollie Gordon II played 84 percent of Miami's snaps after De'Von Achane's injury, and he is the first claim of the week.
